<actions string="Single Action" />
_light hammer_ +18 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [thrown 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=195)),
**Damage** 2d6+5 bludgeoning

**Arcane Prepared Spells** DC 26, attack +20
- **Cantrips (4th)**
[Detect Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=66), [Electric Arc](/Spells.aspx?ID=97), [Produce Flame](/Spells.aspx?ID=236), [Shield](/Spells.aspx?ID=280)

[Longstrider](/Spells.aspx?ID=175), [True Strike](/Spells.aspx?ID=345) (×2)
- **2nd**
[Acid Arrow](/Spells.aspx?ID=2), [Knock](/Spells.aspx?ID=168), [See Invisibility](/Spells.aspx?ID=271)
- **3rd**
[Fireball](/Spells.aspx?ID=119), [Invisibility Sphere](/Spells.aspx?ID=165), [Locate](/Spells.aspx?ID=173)

[Dispel Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=78), [Weapon Storm](/Spells.aspx?ID=373)

[Sigil](/Spells.aspx?ID=286)
- **2nd**
[Blood Vendetta](/Spells.aspx?ID=675), [Paranoia](/Spells.aspx?ID=214)

**Wizard School Spells** attack +20, 2 Focus Points
- **1st**
[Hand of the Apprentice](/Spells.aspx?ID=530)

**Tormenter**   Bronwyl deals an additional 2d6 mental damage with weapon Strikes against creatures that are [fatigued](/Conditions.aspx?ID=15), [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=37), or have [persistent damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29).

</column>
